method: Each of the eleven original PNG files was opened individually with view_image after the collector closed Chrome; no montage, generated replacement, DOM or style edit was used.

captures.label: me2-withdrawn
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME2 context visible; Shepard is at -7.4 / 0.0 after the native withdrawal, separated from the two workshop targets.

captures.label: me2-charge-contact
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME2 contact moves Shepard to 2.2 / -2.4 near the 3.8 / -2.8 target; position legend, ATB arena limits and +15% exposure line are legible.

captures.label: me2-charge-exposure
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: Active ME2 status is genuinely visible: Contact de position ATB, exposition +15%, 1 s. The game is paused through its public control.

captures.label: me2-exposure-ended
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: Same contact coordinates remain after natural time resumes; the temporary exposure line is gone.

captures.label: me3-withdrawn
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME3 context and native withdrawal position -7.4 / 0.0 are visible; prototype target identities remain explicit.

captures.label: me3-charge-contact
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME3 contact coordinates, target range display and the native 9.9-unit displacement log are visible; no physical 3D trajectory is represented.

captures.label: me3-charge-exposure
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: Active ME3 status is genuinely visible: Contact de position ATB, exposition +15%, 2 s; Charge impact and shield bars remain distinct.

captures.label: me3-charge-mobile
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: At 390 x 844 the arena, numbered markers, legend and adaptation limits fit within the panel width. The command flow is below the viewport; this is a layout observation, not a complete mobile combat journey.

captures.label: me3-exposure-ended
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: ME3 contact is retained and the temporary exposure line is absent after natural expiration.

captures.label: me2-restarted
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: After actual import/save/browser reload, a fresh ME2 battle starts at -3.8 / 0.0 without the previous exposure or contact coordinates.

captures.label: me3-prologue-isolated
captures.source: Actual public viewport, unchanged DOM/style/state and natural ATB time.
captures.notes: The Earth-prologue context and temporary Anderson are visible; no new arena or Charge action appears.

limitations: Desktop evidence uses a declared native 1280 x 1900 viewport so the real Pause and command controls can remain in one large window; DEV01/02 used a shorter viewport and missed the natural three-second status.
Mobile evidence checks arena layout and horizontal overflow only; no complete mobile command journey is claimed.
The displayed geometry is a bounded two-dimensional ATB arena, not an original map, obstacle collision solver, sprite motion or 3D animation. Other powers retain their documented abstract ranges.
Damage multiplier and exact resource/RNG atomicity are native-test findings; screenshots only establish visible feedback and positions.
No new original models, ranks, class progression, full campaign or artistic fidelity is certified.
